title.zh: Morning Minute: NEAR Intents Hacked for $3.8M - Was It A Bullish Hack?
title.en: Morning Minute: NEAR Intents Hacked for $3.8M - Was It A Bullish Hack?

current_state.zh: NEAR Intents was hacked for roughly $3.8M through a flaw in the layer handling deposits/withdrawals and its interaction with the main fund-holding contract, prompting a brief shutdown while stolen funds were traced to KuCoin and swapped to bitcoin.
current_state.en: NEAR Intents was hacked for roughly $3.8M through a flaw in the layer handling deposits/withdrawals and its interaction with the main fund-holding contract, prompting a brief shutdown while stolen funds were traced to KuCoin and swapped to bitcoin.
